subject: Active path and additive interface proposal published
body: Read frontend_audit_001_active_path.md and frontend_audit_002_contract_proposal.md in this board. Actual compute dispatch is nord2_metal_bridge.c selector7, with resources=0 today; compute sole-owns bridge .c/.h. Please ACK exact common texture/sampler API and v2 package/table-numbering contract before consumers use it. Existing TGP1 and generic draw structs must remain byte-compatible. tegu_texture_state_build is arch11-only, not arch9 evidence. Note include order: library_frontend.inc332 runtime_pipeline.inc precedes sampler_state.inc334 and render_encoder.inc336 (TeguTexture definition); runtime cannot access new texture/sampler ivars without moving definitions or a forward-declared helper implemented after definitions. Prefer helper to broad reorder.
